title: Jasper Marketing AI Platform

identityDecision.scope: Treat Jasper as one marketing AI platform centered on Jasper IQ, Canvas, Agents, Studio, Grid and governed brand context. Do not reduce it to a generic long-form writer or split named capabilities into separate tool pages.
identityDecision.reason: Current product and pricing surfaces sell one marketing platform. Pro serves one user with bounded brand context, while Business adds team, governance, API and credit-metered capabilities.

positioning: A marketing AI platform for governed brand context, repeatable campaign production, agents and scaled workflows, with a one-seat Pro plan and custom Business economics that combine platform access with credits for selected actions.
decisionAngles: Jasper brand-governed marketing workflows versus general-purpose AI drafting
Pro single-seat economics versus custom Business commitments
Unlimited core Chat, Agents, Studio and IQ versus credit-metered premium actions
Two Pro Brand Voices and five Knowledge assets versus unlimited Business IQ customization
Human editorial review and brand consistency versus fully automated publishing
Customer-property protections, third-party processing, DPA and deployment location
Workspace-wide credit pools, per-user controls and unlogged overage-setting changes

plans: Pro: USD 69 per month per seat on monthly billing or USD 59 per month per seat billed yearly, with one included seat and a seven-day trial
Pro context limits: two Brand Voices, five Knowledge assets and three Audiences
Business: custom pricing, generally a 12-month commitment, additional users, unlimited IQ customization, custom agents, Grid, API, SSO and governance
Business credits: included base credits plus prepaid packs or PAYG for API/MCP, Grid output rows and selected advanced Agent/GEO actions
Standard Chat and Canvas creation are not identified as the drivers of credit usage
volatileFields: Pro monthly and annual prices, trial conversion and currency conversion
Business platform fee, included credits and commitments
credit rate card, charged actions and expiration terms
Pro Brand Voice, Knowledge and Audience limits
pricingSnapshot.releaseGuard: Recheck pricing, live credit rates, charged actions, plan limits and cancellation terms on release day. Never combine seat price and credits into an invented effective price.

policyBoundaries.label: Customer property is excluded from model training under the EULA
policyBoundaries.summary: Jasper states it and third parties may not use Customer Property to train AI models used by the service; it can still use de-identified Usage Information and authorized service providers can process Customer Property.
policyBoundaries.releaseGuard: Do not turn a non-training commitment into a claim that content is never processed by third parties or never hosted outside the customer's region.

policyBoundaries.label: Personal data requires the applicable contract path
policyBoundaries.summary: The EULA says effective use does not require personal data and directs customers that submit personal data for processing to execute the DPA. Default hosting may include the US, EEA or UK unless otherwise agreed.
policyBoundaries.releaseGuard: Do not claim a DPA, hosting region or control is active without checking the contract and configuration.

policyBoundaries.label: Brand controls reduce drift but do not remove review
policyBoundaries.summary: Brand Voice learns from examples, can be workspace-visible or private, and can be overridden; Style Guides are Business-only. Jasper's ethics page describes AI as assisting rather than fully automating content creation.
policyBoundaries.releaseGuard: Do not promise factual accuracy, perfect brand compliance or publication-ready output without human review.

policyBoundaries.label: Credits create an operational-governance layer
policyBoundaries.summary: All workspace users can spend credits by default. Admins can disable access and set monthly limits, but overage-setting changes are not currently recorded in the audit log.
policyBoundaries.releaseGuard: Expose shared-pool, expiration, PAYG cap and audit-log limitations instead of calling Business usage unlimited.

limitations: Pro is a one-seat plan; additional users require a customized Business path.
The USD 59 figure is billed yearly, while flexible monthly billing is USD 69 per seat.
Business pricing, included credits and commitment details are not publicly fixed.
Credits are separate from the platform fee and apply to API/MCP, Grid output rows and selected advanced Agent/GEO actions.
Prepaid credits expire at renewal or another contract-defined date.
All workspace users can spend credits by default unless an administrator changes access or limits.
Changes to overage settings are not currently recorded in the audit log.
Pro has two Brand Voices, five Knowledge assets and three Audiences; Style Guides are Business-only.
Workspace-visible Brand Voices can be used by members and users can override a default voice.
Brand and knowledge controls do not guarantee factual accuracy, voice preservation or publication-ready output.
Authorized third parties can process Customer Property even though training is prohibited.
Personal-data processing, DPA coverage and hosting location require contract verification.
Independent feedback includes generic-output, heavy-editing, cancellation, renewal and refund friction.

marketValidation.rationale: Jasper has a durable marketing-AI identity and substantial independent review volume. G2 shows roughly 1.3 thousand reviews and a strong average, while Trustpilot shows more than 4 thousand reviews but a materially lower 3.2 score and recurring billing or editing complaints. The disagreement creates decision value but is not a controlled performance test.
strongSignals: G2 reports roughly 1.3 thousand reviews across several AI categories
Trustpilot reports more than 4 thousand reviews
Official documentation supports a distinct marketing workflow and brand-governance decision
recurringUserFriction: Brand Voice and Knowledge setup work
